description_full: Pelagos Insurance Capital Limited provides insurance and reinsurance solutions in Bermuda, the Republic of Ireland, and the United Kingdom. It operates in two segments: Insurance and Reinsurance. The Insurance segment offers property, marine, asset backed finance and portfolio credit, aviation and aerospace, political risk, violence and terror, energy, cyber, and other insurance risks products. The Reinsurance segment provides property, retrocession, and whole account reinsurance solutions. The company was formerly known as Fidelis Insurance Holdings Limited and changed its name to Pelagos Insurance Capital Limited in May 2026. Pelagos Insurance Capital Limited was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Pembroke, Bermuda.

financial_summary: Pelagos Insurance Capital Limit is a mid-cap financial services business with a $2.3B market cap on $2.5B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -17% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
Returns on capital run at 12% against a 7% cost of capital, a 4-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it.
The company is burning through $410M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage runs at 7.5×.

Management returns a meaningful 14.5% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 12% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.5× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
